nodes.label: AutomaticTester Engine
nodes.rationale: Implements the missing self-improvement/retraining engine that model-improvement-service imports; runs comparisons entirely on CPU locally and hands off LoRA training to Colab/RunPod because the target machine has no GPU. Kept self-contained (no import from main.py) to avoid cycles and reuses the OpenAI-compatible request shape proven in inference.py.

nodes.label: Windows Ollama Setup & Testing Guide
nodes.rationale: Native Windows Ollama install bypasses WSL2 GPU limitations, enabling AMD RX 6900 XT GPU acceleration (4-5x speedup) that WSL2 could not provide.

nodes.label: Cloud GPU Training Guide
nodes.rationale: Cloud GPU training is used because the local AMD RX6900 cannot be used by PyTorch (needs ROCm) and CPU training takes 3-12 days vs 2-4 hours on cloud GPU.

nodes.label: Prometheus Scrape Config
nodes.rationale: Only services that actually expose a Prometheus /metrics endpoint are scraped at their real ports; the previous config pointed at wrong ports and services with no metrics.

nodes.label: Reflexion Learning
nodes.rationale: Automatically compares responses against commercial AI to identify improvement patterns and generate training data; live testing confirmed the reflexion (CoVe) loop works even though the automated retraining glue was a stub.

nodes.label: Pluggable OpenAI-Compatible Inference Backend
nodes.rationale: Rather than bind to vLLM specifically, localllm exposes INFERENCE_BACKEND=ollama|openai so OPENAI_BASE_URL can point at self-hosted GPU (vLLM/SGLang) or a hosted API (Groq/OpenRouter/Together/Gemini) with no local GPU. Chosen because Ollama degrades under concurrency; verified live against Groq (~0.24s vs ~4.8s local Ollama).

nodes.label: Internal Service-to-Service Auth
nodes.rationale: Shared internal_auth.py (require_internal_key + internal_headers) opt-in via INTERNAL_API_KEY: unset = allowed-with-warning for dev, set = enforced for production. localllm keeps its own Bearer key; browser-facing orchestration inbound stays open by design.

nodes.label: vLLM Inference Server
nodes.rationale: vLLM sustains 180+ concurrent users where Ollama collapses at ~10-40; offers PagedAttention, continuous batching, and hot-swappable Unsloth LoRA adapters via --enable-lora.

nodes.label: Ollama
nodes.rationale: Local model serving default; a single-user/dev tool that degrades under concurrency.

nodes.label: Groq Reference/Judge Model
nodes.rationale: Groq (free) is the default reference and judge model to avoid burning Anthropic/Claude credits; Claude can be enabled later via env.

nodes.label: Redis Cache
nodes.rationale: Holds API keys, cache and rate-limit state; not published to the host and requires a password, reachable only on the internal compose network.

nodes.label: Google Colab (T4 GPU)
nodes.rationale: Recommended training platform because it is free (T4 GPU) vs paid RunPod/Vast.ai alternatives.
